about: Reviewed places where two active Octatrack modules meet on the same stock bytes; read by scripts/module-compat.py (npm run modules:compat, part of npm run check). Any overlap not listed here fails, and so does an entry naming a module that is no longer active or a site where nothing meets any more. Shared behaviour goes through the base's events and tables (sdk/machines/octatrack/events.json): a module subscribes or contributes in its runtime.json and never patches their sites. group-owned: one module's reviewed composition owns every listed site. pending-migration: allowed only until both modules subscribe to the named event. New entries need owner review; for shared behaviour, request an event or a table instead (docs/module-guides/README.md#propose-an-event).
